description: A Dina node's public A2A Agent Card, for the trust-ranked directory (docs/A2A_GATEWAY_ARCHITECTURE.md §8.2). One per repository.

card.description: The JWS-signed Agent Card as RFC 8785 canonical JSON, byte-identical to what /.well-known/agent-card.json serves.

directory_envelope.description: {v, domain, did, collection, rkey, card_hash, freshness_epoch, publisher_epoch, publisher_instance, sig}: signed by the DID document's #dina_signing key over its RFC 8785 form without sig; card_hash is the sha256 of the card string's UTF-8 bytes.

endpoint.description: The card's JSON-RPC interface URL. Must equal the card's.

protocol_version.description: The card's JSON-RPC interface protocol version. Must equal the card's.

skills.description: The card's skill ids in order: capability or capability@rkey. Must equal the card's.
